description:
ROOT CAUSE of the 'build-schedule nondeterministic 00181 stall' (fz-go4.18.40): commit 6dd4bb48a (fz-go4.22 test re-ignore) ACCIDENTALLY truncated fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz from 476 bytes to 0. The commit message only describes re-ignoring 3 tests; the 14-line fixture deletion was unintended collateral (the working tree was already emptied when the red was observed, and the commit baked it in). The 3 tests include_str! the fixture at COMPILE time, so they drove EMPTY source -> main/0 was never defined -> demand_function_scope(0) returned empty -> PublishFunctionSource(0) waited solely on the arm-less FunctionSourceStash(0) -> the FunctionSource/SeedRoot chain deterministically stalled. This exactly matches the stall shape in fz-go4.18.40 (PublishFunctionSource(FunctionId(0)) waiting on Current(FunctionSourceStash(FunctionId(0))) alone).

There was NEVER real scheduler nondeterminism. The fz-go4.18.40 investigation built a commit with the NON-EMPTY fixture and got green on 11 runs (5 repeats + 6 rebuilds + release) and 'could not reproduce' -- because with real fixture content there is nothing to reproduce. The 'green on one build, red on another' was empty-working-tree vs committed-non-empty, not a hasher-seed/layout effect.

FIX: restore the fixture to its pre-truncation content (git blob 0faabab61: main() returning {Enum.reduce([1,2,3],0,&Kernel.+/2), Enum.reduce([1,2,3],0,&+/2)}) and remove the 3 #[ignore] attributes 6dd4bb48a added -- a full reversal of 6dd4bb48a's damage. VERIFIED: with the fixture restored, all 3 tests pass deterministically across 3 layout-perturbed rebuilds.

ATTRIBUTION: this is NOT what fz-go4.18.41 fixed. fz-go4.18.41 closed a real but SEPARATE latent deadlock (global function whose home code is still Pending when PublishFunctionSource runs). With a non-empty 00181 fixture, main/0's home code indexes before SeedRoot (front-door FIFO), so demand_function_scope(0) hits the found-home branch and never exercises .41's new terminal path -- the 3 tests pass from fixture restoration, independent of .41. Both are real; they are unrelated.
title: Restore accidentally-truncated fixture 00181 and re-enable its 3 gate tests (fz-go4.22 collateral; there was no real nondeterminism)
